utterances.text: Can you please now draw a line, according to what you deduced in your report, corresponding to a north-westerly direction with respect to the impact point?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]. I did it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you draw it all the way to the impact point?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can do that [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Start from the impact point.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Okay, that's fine. According to the report, it flew over Bitumenka. Do you know what was housed in Bitumenka building during the war?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You don't know that it served as a military facility for military production?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please put the date and your signature.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can it be admitted?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D804, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have 65 ter 09819 [as interpreted]. I believe there's no signature there, and, therefore, it can be broadcast. 09189.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: The first page does have a signature. The second and third pages can be broadcast, indeed.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we go straight to page 3.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you familiar with this sketch?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This sketch represents the place where the projectile landed next to a building number 10 at Trg Medjunarodnog Prijateljstva.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please explain to everyone present -- you mentioned the dimensions 1110 and 780, and in this particular case you defined characteristic points with respect to the building.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: By using this sketch, can you please mark the direction from which the projectile arrived, or is it already marked? Is that number 4?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this dotted line marked "4" indicates the direction from which the projectile came.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And the north is correctly marked here; is that right?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, north should be corrected slightly upwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, please do that.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]. In fact, that's how it should be.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So number 4, this line, is -- indicates the line of the direction, and it corresponds with the longer axis of the crater?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Since we have entered some changes, can we please have the date and number 166.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is it possible that this projectile came from Lukavica?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: In my opinion, no, it couldn't have come from Lukavica.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In the summary, it is said that Incident 15 from the G list, the projectile came from Lukavica. Table G. So something is not correct here; is that right?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. However, in the summary which was prepared by Mr. Mujo Musagic, he says that, according to his opinion, the projectile most likely came from Lukavica, most probably. But my opinion, based on the diametre of the crater, which is cylindrically shaped, I deduced that it came from the direction of west or north-west.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we please have this admitted into evidence, this sketch?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D805, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at 1D2637 now, please. Just one moment, please. Can we look at the whole image. This is a zoomed-in section of Google Maps.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you see Bitumenka and the PTT buildings here? And if so, can you please mark them here on this image.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, just one moment. Let me take a look first.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, you can look at the location of the incident.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]. This is Bitumenka, I think. I don't know if it's the whole thing, but Bitumenka is here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All right, thank you. Can you mark that with the number 1?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, here is the number 1 [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: PTT?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: And this is the PTT Engineering building [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you put the number 2 next to the PTT building, and can you mark the location where the incident occurred with the number 3.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks] Yes. The location of the incident is approximately here. Which number should I mark it with?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: With the number 3.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: This is the pedestrian path along which the projectile dropped; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: It fell on the pedestrian path, on it precisely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we have the date and "KDZ166," please.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And can you mark the direction from which the projectile came, in your opinion?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks] I've marked it.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we tender this, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D806, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now look at 1D2638, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that with this Google, this picture, this diagram is placed, and that the direction of the street, or the main street, or the boulevard, the Bulevar Mese Selimovica, actually shown in the sketch is an extension of what is shown on the Google?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree, then, that these two parallel lines marked with the 1 and 2 indicate what you marked as the direction of the projectile that created this crater?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that this sketch shows the incoming trajectory, marked with the number 1, passing above the Bitumenka?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Line number 2 indicates the pedestrian path or the edge of the building where the shell dropped; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we tender this?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Did you say line number 2 or 3?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 3. Lines 1 and 2 are the same. They are parallel. They indicate the direction. Line number 3 actually indicates the direction of the pedestrian path or the wall of that side of the building.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Unless it is objected to, we will admit this.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Very well, no objection, again these lines having been placed there by the Defence team.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit D807.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We've lost the picture, it's gone, but actually we should have corrected that north there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And having that in mind, we thus agree that this projectile came from the north-west - here it is - isn't that right? And the north-east is corrected here, isn't it? And the shell came from the north-west, above the Bitumenka factory; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Sorry, objection. The last part of Mr. Karadzic's question said "The shell came from the north-west." I don't know if that's a mistranslation, but the evidence is not that this was a shell. The evidence is that this was a modified air-bomb.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] "Projectile," if it's easier, "projectile." Thank you. We're going to move to the next incident. Has this been adopted, has it got a number; no?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, it was admitted as Exhibit D807.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You also processed this incident of the 24th of May in the Safeta Zajke Street; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What was the name of that street before it was called Safeta Zajke Street?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I couldn't say.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do we agree that it was perhaps Drinska Street, but, in any case, it's a continuation of Drinska Street?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I really couldn't tell you, specifically, because I wasn't familiar with that street before the war.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we look at 65 ter 21214, please. 21214.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you familiar with this part of the panorama of the city of Sarajevo?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I'm familiar with this view. In the middle of the photograph is the building of the radio-television of Bosnia and Herzegovina. In front of that building, closer to us, is the building of the Municipal Assembly, and then next to the Municipal Assembly is the building of the Geodesic Institute. A little bit in front of that is the transformer station building.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you kindly mark all of those places with numbers. Let's start with the television building. Could you mark that with the number 1, please.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks] Number 1.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Number 2, the Municipal Assembly of Novo Sarajevo?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Not Novo Sarajevo, but Municipal Assembly of Novi Grad [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's right, Novi Grad. Number 3, the Geodesic Institute?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Here's the Geodesic Institute [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Number 4, the transformer station building?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks] Number 4, done.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you see the police station building?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just a moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It's south in relation to the number 4.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's south in relation to number 4, but I'm just trying to orient myself. You cannot really see it very well on this image, the police station building. Actually, the police station building is here. Shall I mark it with the number 5?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, please do.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: That's correct, thank you. Can you now mark the Majdanska axis?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Majdanska Street [marks]. Just below the number 4, the Majdanska Street is marked in blue.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Does it go up towards Safeta Hadzica, towards us?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it lies towards us. From the Municipal Assembly building towards us.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please mark that in the middle?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mark what?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The middle line of the street going towards Majdanska.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this is what I've indicated below the number 4 with the blue line.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And does it end there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know if it continues onwards. I'm not sure where the street forks. The place where I stopped is the intersection, so I don't know in which direction it continues.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could Mr. Karadzic please repeat his question?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What was behind the television --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The interpreters couldn't follow your last question.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I said that we're not going to be marking the western part of the photograph now. I asked the witness to tell us what this big industrial building is behind the television building.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I think that that is the building of the wire factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please mark that with the number 6.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And do you see these buildings farther to the east, the red ones? What are those buildings?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: All of that is the wire factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you put the number 6 above those buildings as well, please.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And do you know where Sik, Graz, and Uniklima are? Do you know where Uniklima is there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I know where Sik is. It's here [marks]. It's below the wire factory buildings, approximately -- approximately here [marks], let's say. I've marked it with the number 7. That is the Sik building.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And the Uniklima is a little bit farther to the east in relation to that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And these domes, this is Igman; is that correct? Actually, is that Astra, is that Astra?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, that is the building of the Sarajevo City Transport Company.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can I please ask you to mark in Majdanska and Safeta Zajke? Do you agree that Safeta Zajke is immediately across the street? If you can mark the Safeta Zajke Street length-wise, and if you can use red to indicate how the street lies.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just one moment, please. [Marks] This is Safeta Zajke Street, approximately.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we have number 7 -- no, number 8? Can I get number 8?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can I ask you now to mark where the projectile dropped on the Safeta Zajke Street as we see it marked on this photograph?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I couldn't really mark it precisely. Looking at this photograph, I cannot tell where the projectile fell. If you have some photographs that are more tightly focused on the location, perhaps I could tell you that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you indicate where the projectile dropped in Majdanska Street, perhaps?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can do it for Majdanska. The projectile impacted here [marks], let's say.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we mark this with the number 9?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: An arrow. Actually, we have the number 9, and the spot -- the dot above the number 9 indicates the location where the projectile fell?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would it help in this case if --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If you don't mind, the witness may take a look at the map which is in front of him, which was shown to him during the examination-in-chief. And after consulting that map, he can mark the place on this picture.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I was just going to say that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And you can use the map. I can also offer the map for you, or perhaps you have it in front of you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If the usher is kind enough to show him Sheet 11 of this binder. Is that Sheet 11? That's the exhibit we admitted as P1803, and you confirmed that. Do you remember that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Do I remember what?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think you were asked only about 15. I'm not sure whether he was asked about green 11.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: I think that's correct, we didn't -- we didn't deal with green 11.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That was my mistake. Can you confirm or not that the number 11, marked as green, reflects the place the incident took place?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can confirm that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Then could you mark on this picture where it would be.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If I can be of assistance.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this in line -- along the same line north-south, 13, 12, 17, 11; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, you can see it's right here [indicates]. Should I put a number there?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, perhaps you can put an arrow there and the number 10 next to it.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: This is precisely above the Vase Miskin Crni factory; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. That factory, Vase Miskin Crni, was some way off. This is actually close to the factory -- the wire factory in Pofalici.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, my apologies. So this is just above the -- right over the wire factory, behind the PTT building; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, would you leave the number 10 there, then, or would you move it a bit to the east?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't really be more specific. As you can see yourself in this photo, these are family homes. They're at the bottom of the photo, so that you can't even see the street, itself, let alone the buildings, the demolished buildings.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter correction: The family homes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But above the PTT building, closer -- behind the TV, if you look at the map, to the north-west, the bearings are 13, 12, 17, 11, if you look at that, that's in line with that, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: 17 and 11 have the south-south-east bearing.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, thank you. To make sure there is no misunderstanding, there is no mention made of the PTT building. Everything we've said here had to do with the TV building and the wire factory. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, would you please -- could you please date and indicate "KDZ166" as a signature there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to tender this, if I may.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D808, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Have you already said that you did not know that shells were produced in this wire factory, in this compound?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I didn't know that.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we have 1D02171.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: While we are waiting for that: How far is that factory, the wire factory, from the incident site; 50 or 100 metres away?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, I think it's a bit further away.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, you tell us.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't really tell you as I sit here, but I think it's about 300 to 500 metres away. I can't really be very precise because there is a railway track running there and then there is a green area, so I can't really be precise.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. We can actually look at Map 11 and measure that. Now, would you please take a look at the report by Mr. Zecevic, where he speaks about the production of mortar ammunition that is cast in this factory.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Why do we not have an English version of this? We should.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, we're looking for the number of that right now. It's not indicated in the list Defence gave us. We're trying to find it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Let's move on, in the meantime, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we see number 11 just one more time in order to establish how far the factory is from the incident site. That's 65 ter 13564.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Or shall we see the marked version?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We can see the marked version as well, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm afraid that's a photo, but what I am asking for is the Map 11.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Witness, do you agree that we have a scale at the bottom which shows and marks -- each bar is 100 or 200 metres?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you agree that 100 metres here is represented as 1 centimetre? And if necessary, we can measure that.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes, approximately.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that between the closest edge of the factory and the incident point, there is less than 1 centimetre on the map, in other words, less than 100 metres?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no, I think it's a bit more, it's a bit longer or farther away.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, here, I'll give you this scale ruler, and maybe you can look at it. It is less than 100 metres. Just compare it to the scale ruler.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think the witness has the original map in front of him.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Here we have the scale, and it is my position that this is about 70 to 80 metres away, the closest edge, the closest corner of this factory, because if we look at the scale ruler, we see that it's between .7 and .8 centimetres.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, according to this scale ruler, it is about 100 metres away.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Could we now please have 1D2634.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You made the sketch for this incident as well; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you actually -- does this sketch consist of two different parts, when you drew it, and we actually put them together? Are these the two separate -- the two parts of the same sketch?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, they are.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you tell us what kind of surface this projectile landed on.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: The projectile landed on an asphalt road, a paved road. A crossroads, actually, on a paved road.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Is the north, as indicated here, correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Does that mean that Safeta Zajke Street, in relation to the north, actually forms an angle -- an obtuse angle?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the Safeta Zajke Street is at about a 90-degree angle to the north line.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Then we would need to correct the indication for north here; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, just a little bit, but it's approximately at an angle of 90 degrees to it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you then please draw a line along the Safeta Zajke Street and Esada Midzica? Would you just draw the lines to meet so that we can see what angle they form.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you then mark the north here on this sketch.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, could we rotate this sketch by 180 degrees, or, rather, by 90 degrees? You're correct.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could you please rotate it by 90 degrees to the left.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. We can mark it again.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, the other way.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. What Mr. Karadzic asked you, Mr. Witness, was to draw a line along with those two streets. I'm not sure whether it's necessary, but could you mark the correct direction of north on this sketch, Mr. Witness?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So we can see that there is a deviation of several degrees; maybe 25 to 30 degrees?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I would say 15 degrees to 20 degrees.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. According to your findings, the findings of your on-site investigative team, what type of projectile landed there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: In my view, this was a modified air-bomb.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you know what made Mr. Zecevic claim that this was an aerosol bomb?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I'm not an expert on ballistics or explosive devices. But in my experience, when I attended other on-site investigations, I know that this bomb had rocket motors fitted on them, and they were used -- that's the Oganj rocket type, and these rocket motors were used with modified air-bombs. But I really can't tell you, because I'm not an expert, what exact type of bomb this was.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, on the sketch here, you only indicated the shrapnel fragments and some other points. Could you please tell us what you showed and marked on this sketch here.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, on this sketch I marked, with a number 0, my vantage point. That's where I began -- that's where I started compiling this sketch from.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Go on.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Numbers 1, 2 and 3 indicate the point of impact of the shell, or that projectile, and also projectile fragments that were found in the crater that was left behind the projectile. Number 3 indicates shrapnel or debris from this bomb that exploded.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. How did you determine what the position of the crater was, and did you do it yourself or did you have some assistance?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the position of this crater was not a difficult thing to determine because the crater was of cylindrical shape, it was an elongated cylinder, and you could clearly see -- based on that, you could easily conclude where this projectile had come from.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Who measured the sizes of the crater?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And why did you not indicate the measurements here that would help to exactly determine the position of this crater? Why are those measurements missing from this sketch?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, quite the contrary, we do have the measurements. I proceeded from this point, point 0, and the other point -- reference point along the street, as the starting points, and then I connected the apex of the crater and the base of the crater with lines, the triangle there, and I have indicated exactly the measurements of the point where the crater was -- where the impression of the crater was. This could perhaps be moved a little bit to the west along Safeta Zajke Street, perhaps some 100 metres farther to the west. That's perhaps where this crater should be.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, let's do it. Can you make it in this sketch?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this sketch is okay the way I made it. What I'm referring to is the general view of the town. When we looked at number 11, it is a little bit to the west.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Why don't we have the measurements of the sides of this angle? "Sides of the triangle." I am correcting the record. The length of the kathete of the triangle.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. Apparently, I haven't recorded them.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said that the crater was 250 centimetres long, 130 wide, and 30 centimetres deep; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You signed that and handed it in on the 25th of May, 1995; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Why is it, then, that in the official report we have different measurements? Let's look, for example, on page -- but before that, can we have this admitted into evidence, and then we call up another document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Does he need to sign it, mark it in any way?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. If you could do that, Mr. Witness. That will be Exhibit D809.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have 65 ter 0 --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I note the time. It's time for a break. We'll break for half an hour. You do not have much time left, so plan your cross-examination to conclude as soon as possible. We'll resume at 20 to 1.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Tieger.

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. I need to raise one scheduling matter briefly. I've already broached this with the Defence. Yesterday afternoon, we were advised by the Victim and Witness Unit that the next witness has requested a Dutch interpreter. Because it was a holiday, there was little we could do yesterday, so we attempted immediately this morning to make arrangements through the proper channels within the ICTY to schedule an interpreter. Although we were initially informed that it could not be done for a matter of two to three weeks, it now appears that we will have an interpreter for tomorrow morning. But it was impossible to arrange one for today. We'll, of course, keep the Court apprised if the current information somehow changes, but that seems to be the status at the moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Tieger. Yes, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. If I may observe, in light of this information, that that means that I'm going to have some more time for the remaining three incidents; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Please move on, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Witness, do you have any explanation why the size of the crater differs from those that you have given? And I'm referring to the sizes in the official report, as opposed to your report.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I have no explanation for that. What I did is what I did, and what others wrote in the official report is what they wrote.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you like us to call up this report so that you can see it?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. It's not relevant to me. I did what I wrote down, and I don't know what other people did or what they wrote down.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] May I ask the Registry whether this official report was admitted into evidence? Can I have 65 ter 09775, page 1. And we need not broadcast it. If it's not in evidence, can we please have it admitted, and can it be only shown in the courtroom without being broadcast? Is this page 1?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you recognise it? Do you recognise your name under one of those numbers?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Let's look at the last paragraph, and you can see that these measurements differ from the ones that you provided; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we have this admitted into evidence?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D810, under seal, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you visit the site the following day or the same day?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the same day.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: At what time did the incident happen?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know exactly the hour. All I know is that we examined the crime scene on the same day.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: At what time did you go to the site?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot tell you, precisely, the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you remember what kind of weather it was on that day?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was a nice, sunny day.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is it true that you had received information about this shell at 1400 hours?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot give you any accurate and precise answer.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we please have again the last document, D810.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It would be very important, how long it took you to get to the scene.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, let me tell you this: The procedure of visiting the crime scene is as follows: In the area of a particular public security station where an incident happens, the inspector on duty gathers a team, an investigating team, to visit the crime scene. And all these people who are supposed to go to the investigation site, that is to say, the judge, the criminal investigation inspector, the criminal investigation technician, the counter-sabotage technician, all of them from that station get together at the station that covers the specific part of the town.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you accept what is written in paragraph 2, that you visited the scene at 1400 hours?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we please have -- now have 65 ter 09773, and we can go straight to page 3. If there's something on page 1, that something should be -- should not be broadcast. But let's correct the transcript. I think it should state "1430."

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's what you said.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But that is what is written in the report?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So you took these photographs at 1430 hours; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Based on these shades, can you tell us the orientation of the incident site?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't do that based on the shades.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Where would the sun be -- the position of the sun be at 1430 hours? Can we agree that it is somewhere to the south, at zenith at 1430?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, the sun would have passed the zenith point at 1430.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We are talking about summertime, 1430, in May, which should be 1330 regular time; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So the sun is towards the south, and it's casting the shadow to the north?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we then deduce that the remnants of this engine are casting a shadow approximately to the north?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. Viewed from this angle, it seems that they're casting the shadow towards the east. If we suppose that the north coincides with the direction of the shadow, then the east would be to the right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But where is this shadow pointing if the sun is on the south?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I suppose towards the north.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So where from did this projectile come?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, in my report, I stated that it was the south-easterly direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would, then, these fragments be distributed or laid as it is if it had come from the south-east?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, let me tell you that -- let me tell you -- well, the way that you are thinking, you can put them in all directions. However, I can tell you, with full responsibility, that this was a pretty clear case, because the crater was cylindrical -- it was in the shape of an elongated cylinder, and based on that shape, one can determine the direction from which the projectile came.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. So this shadow points approximately towards the north, and the sun is in the south; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, you can't put it exactly like that. You cannot take things into account in that manner. It could be just one of the ways to look at it. If you look at how these rocket motors that propelled the projectile are stuck into the ground, and when the fuel burned out, it was consumed by the rocket motor, the projectile started descending, and eventually it landed. Now, how it landed, and after the detonation and the explosion, how its fragments are distributed, it's the subject for a philosophical discussion, not a serious one.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, we need a serious one. Tell me, in the photograph below, can you mark the longer -- is the longer one between 1 and 2?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. Roughly speaking, that's the direction of the crater, the cylinder that was made by this projectile at impact.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you connect the longer axis between 1 and 2 of the crater with one line?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please put the date.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And I would like to tender this into evidence. Can this be admitted into evidence?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D811, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have 1D2634.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: While we are waiting: Can we agree that you made a sketch here in two segments and that we put them together like we did the last time? Did you make this sketch?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What was the approximate length of the motor -- of the rocket motor that was found in the crater?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot tell you exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Nobody measured them; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I didn't.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In the report on the criminal investigation of the site, it was decided that the projectile that landed there was probably a modified aerial bomb with four rocket motors. On the basis of which did you determine the number of motors?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I will answer your previous question concerning the length of the rocket motor. In the previous photograph, one can see the cylinder of the rocket, and the first section of the cylinder is actually the engine or the motor, and it's a smaller part of the cylinder. The bigger part of the cylinder is the place where the fuel is stored, and the engine, itself, consumes this fuel during its flight. In other words, this cylinder is made up of two sections; the motor and the fuel storage section. Now, as for your second question, how did we arrive at the conclusion that there were four motors, four rocket motors, that was our assumption because it was logical that if you have an object that you want to project into a sloped trajectory from all four points, you need to attach the motors that will carry it evenly through the air so, once you fire it, it will have an even trajectory.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Why do you say "most probably"? Because you couldn't establish that beyond any doubt?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, let me tell you something. This was non-standard weapons. It was not a weapon from the arsenal of any army. It was a make-shift weapon made by attaching rocket motors to the bombs. Normally, the bombs are dropped from planes, but your soldiers manufactured this weapon in order to fire it from the ground, from the trucks. It was mounted on trucks.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did your soldiers have that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, they didn't.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How do you know that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, you know very well our soldiers didn't have any weapons at all, almost, so it was very difficult. You know that very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did both sides -- or did all of the three sides have the weapons that they inherited from the Yugoslav People's Army?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, all the sides had such kind of weapons. The only difference was that the Bosnian side, the majority of its weapons were light weapons, whereas the Bosnian Serb side had all types of weapons that existed in the arsenal of the former Yugoslav People's Army, and that's a huge difference.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We're not going to tackle this subject any further. Can we now look at 65 ter 10350, page 2. And do not broadcast it.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This is Exhibit P1811. It's a public exhibit.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, under B, does it say -- just a moment. Number 7, it says that this was most probably a modified aerial bomb with four rocket motors. Are you familiar with what kind of rockets Plamen and Oganj have and how many rockets each of them have -- or, rather, how many motors each of these rockets have?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't know much about multiple rocket-launchers. But during investigations that I conducted, I had an opportunity to come across their motors, and that's, more or less, all I know about it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did the BH Army in Sarajevo have a multiple rocket-launcher?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know that.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have 65 ter 09786, please, page 3. 09786.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: While we are waiting for that to come up: How is it possible that the report states that there were five rockets recovered, based on the debris that you collected on site, actually?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't answer that question because I did not participate in the on-site investigation itself. That was done by other people, and they conducted their investigation on the basis of the recovered trace evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, take a look here. It says here in the other -- in the first paragraph here, it says that these were -- actually, on the first page, the first bullet says: "Five steel deformed tubes ..." Whereas it says that four rockets of 128 millimetres were recovered. Can you see this?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have page 3, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, and here we can see it says a Grad-type rocket, and we can see here that: "The device described above was most probably made of a destructive fab contact fuse aircraft bomb and five 122-millimetre Grad-type rockets which served as a power unit." So here it says "122-millimetre Grad-type rockets," whereas there it said "122 millimetre" and "Oganj rockets." So how did that happen?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't really answer that question, because I'm not an expert for explosive devices, nor am I a ballistics expert. My responsibility was just to collect the trace evidence and to hand them over to experts who were to conduct their expertise.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But do you agree with me that these were 122-millimetre Grad-type rockets or Oganj 128 millimetres?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't really tell you with any accuracy.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, if I were to tell you that the BH Army did have VBRs, what would they fire from those VBRs, the multiple rocket-launchers?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't answer that question.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm afraid that there was an error in the transcript. Oganj is 128-millimetre, that's the calibre, and for Grad, the calibre is 122 millimetres. Very well, thank you. I would like to tender this document now, if that's -- if it hasn't already been admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues]... 1324.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could we have the number again? P ...?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P1324, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If I can just add something. I stated in my report that this was the -- these were the most probable rockets. I really am not an expert on these devices and different types of projectiles.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But it also says, on the first page, that the on-site investigation was conducted on the basis of the trace evidence collected on site; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, would it have been significant if you had -- if you knew that the BH Army did have VBR rocket-launchers, multiple rocket-launchers?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I don't know. I don't know what you want me to answer.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, your conclusion was that this projectile had come from the south-east; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said that it came from the aggressor positions. How did you come to that conclusion, first of all, that it had come from the south-east? And then on what did you base your conclusion that it had come from the aggressor position? I assume that you meant by "aggressor" the Serb position.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, I won't go into that discussion now, but what was the basis on which you determined the incoming trajectory and the range?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not establish the range, nor do I know exactly what the range was, but I do know, and I'm pretty certain of that, that the BH Army did not shell its own positions.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. So was that your criterion?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, that was the only logical conclusion, and that's the only way that one would act. Only a person who is not quite normal would open fire on him or herself.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now please have 1D2635. 1D2635, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that your sketch and the map actually are consistent, that Safeta Zajke Street is consistent on both maps; they overlap?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that the impact point is well marked on the map as well, that it's right across the street from the wire factory?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this incoming trajectory relatively well transferred from the sketch to the map? Does it actually show the exact orientation?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you now see that the inaccurate determination of where the north point is is relevant in this case?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, but we corrected it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, we did. But what, then, about the crater base? Should we correct that as well?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, that should remain as it is, and the south-easterly direction should remain as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, how can they remain the same if the north bearing is different? Then, I assume, the basis of the crater should also be more in a southerly direction.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no, because as a reference point I took this building -- or, rather, the fence around this building which runs parallel to Safeta Zajke Street, so that it is not at all difficult to determine the northerly direction.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I would like to tender this document, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Under the same understanding, i.e., that the marking was done by the Defence, we can admit it. Exhibit D812.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In the official report, it says -- that's 65 ter 09775, on page 1 -- it shouldn't be broadcast, although we did say it was a public document. So 65 ter 09775. It may have already been assigned a P number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Did we not give D810 for that?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The reason why the Court Deputy put it under seal, I take it, is because you named his name appearing on that report. That's why.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Otherwise, we could have put it in the public domain. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No problem, it can be under seal.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, Witness, can you see the last paragraph here? Look at where it says: "The crater produced by the projectile is orientated towards the south," or more correctly, more precisely, "towards Lukavica, where the aggressor's firing line is situated." That's the fifth line in the last paragraph.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I just saw it. That is the official report and the findings of the individual who drafted this report, whereas I drafted my own report, and I stand by what I wrote.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And then it goes on to say the crater -- "Two pipes, the ends of a 128-millimetre rocket, were found in the crater, with a fuel reservoir and a rocket motor. Wings, rocket stabilisers were found close and wrapped around with steel wire. The tails were facing south towards Lukavica." And here we can see that they were actually orientated towards the south. So how is it that these findings actually differ from your conclusions?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I did not draw the conclusions that you inferred. Your inference was your conclusion, and I stand by what my conclusions were. Now, what you are proposing here is a hypothesis that is purely of a philosophical nature.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now just briefly pull up the sketch that we just saw a moment ago.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, how much longer do you need?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, we have two remaining incidents that we would like to deal with, and that's without the incident involving the death of the little girl.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, Witness, would you agree with me that the direction that you marked there was not the southerly direction and that the southerly direction would actually be at the perpendicular angle to this image?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes, I agree. This is actually the south/south-easterly direction.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, thank you. Very well, thank you. No, we don't need this sketch anymore.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, conclude in 15 minutes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, Your Excellency, I absolutely cannot manage that. We both have Hrasnica and Majdanska Street, and these are two very significant incidents for my case, because if I were unable to question this witness, that would mean that my defence was not properly completed. Now, to give me three hours for five incidents, that's really --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, you wasted a lot of time asking repetitive questions, useless questions. We'll conclude this witness today and leave two or three minutes at the end for an administrative matter.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, can we extend today's session through 2.30?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That's a very interesting question. Let me check the court schedule today. I need to hear from the staff, which I will hear --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Would it be agreeable to the Prosecution, Mr. Gaynor?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: That's fine, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's carry on, Mr. Karadzic. But we need to -- in any event, that being possible as well, we need to have a short break to change the tape.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. We will save some time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, you recall, Witness, that -- you recall the Majdanska incident. That was on the 24th of May, and that's Schedule 12 in Appendix 6. Now, could you recall which happened first? Well, you've marked Majdanska Street on the photo. We don't need to pull it up again; right? Without pulling this photo, D808, would you agree with me that in the industrial zone, there were no residential areas?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Do you mean on Majdanska Street?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: No, I mean that part of the city where the industrial area is.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the industrial park, most of the installations there are industrial plants, and there are perhaps a few residential buildings. There are some, but not very many.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now please have 65 ter 09774, and that should not be broadcast.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, did you draft the sketch for this incident as well?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Who took the measurements?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What did you use for your measurements?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the measuring band.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What kind of ground did this projectile land on?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: This projectile landed on a soft surface, soil, the ground along the street. There is a slight slope there, and the projectile struck the ground, making a furrow, a deep furrow, a long cylinder in the ground.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And what was the ground; asphalt or soil?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was soil.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Could we now have 1D2630.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this a sketch that you drew?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you -- the indication for north here, is it correct or should it be slightly altered? More specifically, what is the orientation of the transformer station there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, we could -- it should be corrected a bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you do it on this sketch, please? Could you indicate that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What angle of deviation is that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: 15 to 20 degrees.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Sold, but let's continue. It could be more, actually. Are you able to indicate on this sketch the incoming trajectory of the projectile?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's indicated by a broken line here marked with the number 8. That is the incoming trajectory of the projectile.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is that the direction or orientation? Where did the projectile come from?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: The projectile came from the direction of the south-east.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How did you determine this direction?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I determined the direction, just like in the previous case, on the basis of the place of impact of the projectile, because the place of impact of the projectile was of a cylindrical shape, five metres long and two metres wide.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we tender this diagram, please, with the corrected direction of the north, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Is a signature and a date necessary?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit D813; correct?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have 65 ter 09774, and can we have page 2 of that document, please. There is a legend for your diagram there.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This has been admitted as Exhibit P1812, under seal.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, this is the legend for the diagram.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that only places are indicated, or the locations where the projectiles were found, or fragments of projectiles, but there are no markings indicating the characteristic points of craters?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, absolutely not, because you can clearly see all the dimensions, all the sides of the triangles that I drew that have to do with this particular incident. All the locations marked in the legend as 1, 2, 3, 4 and so forth, indicate -- are marked by kathetes of the triangle, and they point to the transformer station.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What is the significance of the -- what are the referent points of the crater? Where is the shorter and the longer axes of the crater?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: They are indicated on the sketch. On the sketch, on the diagram, you have the beginning point of the crater and the end point of the crater. You also have the dimensions marked using triangles and kathetes in relation to the transformer station.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at the diagram again, because then you can see that this is not there. D812.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 813, yes, 813.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Where is the crater here, Witness, sir?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, let me just wait. Can we zoom in on the diagram, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But then we'll lose the legend. Where are the elements indicating the position of the crater?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: The point marked with the number 1 is where we have two kathetes. One kathete is 2.250 centimetres long and the second one is 1.600 centimetres. So we have these two kathetes indicate -- marking the location marked with the number 1. That is the point of impact of the projectile.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And what are the kathetes drawn in relation to?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: They are drawn in relation to the transformer station. That is the reference point.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What is it in relation to? This number 2, what is that in relation to, this "640"?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: That is the angle of the transformer station, and this is where I indicated the letters "S.T." which means the fixed point. That's where I was standing when I began to draw this sketch.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And this is the shape of the crater, that is five metres long and two metres broad? It's not professionally drawn, is it?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In relation to this north now, what would you add to this diagram?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Nothing.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you change anything in relation to the direction?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. The incoming trajectory I established in relation to the crater. That was the reference point.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said here that you found some rocket fuel. How do you explain that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no. I think I mentioned a part of the rocket engine with a part of the rocket fuel container.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Oh, all right. The fuel was not found?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: During the flight of the projectile, the fuel is spent. When the fuel is spent, the projectile falls in free-fall. That's how it works.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you find any characteristic elements of the projectile, such as the jets, the fins, the engine chambers, and so on?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think, yes, that we did find some. We need to look at the list of the remains or the traces.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at the document underneath this one. It's part of this document also. P1812, please, page 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Witness, while we're waiting: You did conduct criminal investigations somewhat differently in peacetime; is that right?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, I don't know what you mean.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would investigations like this be acceptable in peacetime? Would they have been accepted?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: In peacetime --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What is your question, Mr. Karadzic?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All right. Now, let's see what you found here. Did you find any characteristic remains of the projectile; fins, parts of the rocket's engine, engine chambers, casings?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: 1, place of impact of the projectile, the connective metal of the projectile. Number 2, part of the container with rocket fuel. 3, shrapnel. Then 6, bigger pieces of shrapnel. That's that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this something that is specific? On the basis of these fragments, are you able to tell what the object is?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I never had the job of saying what it was. All I needed to do was to assume what it was, and then the forensic experts, ballistics experts, on the basis of collected fragments and shrapnel, remains of the projectile, would give their opinion. And their opinion was official.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. To whom did you give your part of the report, then, and was that included in the final report? Did they use your report when drafting the final report?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know whether they used my report in order to draft the final report. I handed my report to my chief, the chief of the Criminal Investigations Unit.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we look at page 2 of 09775, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Well, here, do you agree that the crater was described differently than the description that you gave? We're looking at the last paragraph: Length, five metres. Width, 1.5 metres. Depth, 1.5 metres along the length of it. It was facing towards the south, and we saw from your diagram that that wasn't quite so.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: The length is the same here. My width is two metres, and his is 1.5, and that is the difference. As for the orientation, the direction from which the projectile came, this is an opinion of the person who wrote this report. And I wrote my report, and I stand by what I put in my report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And is the depth different?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know exactly what my depth was.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said it was two metres.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, then it is different.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What I'm particularly interested in is: How come, then, that the direction from which the projectile came is different?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot give you an answer to that. The gentleman who wrote this report wrote it on the basis of information of his own, and I wrote as best as I could, I wrote my report.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: If we're talking about a modified air-bomb, how many rocket engines would you expect to find there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I couldn't answer exactly how many rocket engines would be there. However, this is not relevant, because in order for us to think that it was a modified air-bomb, we were more or less sure there, and it was easy to tell that apart from a mortar shell of 120 millimetres, because the modified air-bomb created a crater that was much, much bigger than the one a mortar shell of 120 millimetres would create. The difference is enormous, and it's very obvious to anyone who's looking.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: If you didn't find more than one rocket engine, why didn't you think or at least investigate the possibility that it could be a rocket from a multi-barrel rocket-launcher?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: One rocket from a multiple rocket-launcher would not be able to create a crater of this size.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It has to be an air-bomb, then. How many engines, at a minimum, are necessary to propel an air-bomb?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know how many engines an air-bomb would have. We assume that you would need three or four, five, but we didn't produce these engines. I didn't work on the modification and perfecting of that particular weapon, so I wasn't familiar with it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All right, thank you. In your report, you said that the projectile came from the direction of Paljevo; is that correct? Paljevo or Prljevo?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Paljevo, Paljevo, yes, more or less. I said south-east. That's important.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] From the direction of the south-east. All right. Can we now have 1D02631. 1D02631.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: If you say "Paljevo," then you also established or decided on the distance, in a way; is that correct? Has this document been tendered? If not, I would like this part of the report -- actually, the report to be admitted. 6 -- 9775. 65 ter 09775. Has it been tendered before, has it been admitted?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: It's been admitted as Exhibit D810, under seal, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Witness, sir, do you see Majdanska Street here? It's in a kind of clamp shape. Do you see that on this intersection?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you put a dot? You see the Municipality building there and all those buildings, the TV buildings. Can you indicate where those buildings are? The transformer station?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. And can you now mark the direction from where that came from Paljevo Brdo?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And can you please mark this now? It's not necessary to put any numbers. Well, actually, you can put the number 1 as the point of impact and number 2 as the incoming trajectory.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we date and the witness code so that it can be admitted?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D814, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
