utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have 09775, page 2, so that we can see what the report says. This is not to be broadcast.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In the last paragraph: "The crater ...," with its length, do you see that? "The crater is facing south, which indicates that the rocket was fired from the same spot as the one before: A number of parts of a VBR rocket were found in and around the crater, as well as shrapnel and parts of an aerial bomb. They were photographed and sent ..." And so on and so forth. Where are the photographs of those parts which would indicate that this was an air-bomb and not a VBR rocket?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: All the photographs that I took, I put as part of the photo documentation, so the entire photographed evidence pertaining to the case would also include those photographs that I took.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So it is uncontested that this is orientated towards the south, and it says that the source of fire is the same as in the previous one; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes, but the report -- that report is the report of the gentleman who wrote it, and not mine.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But is this an overall report compiled by the investigative team?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, this was a report that was drafted by that gentleman, and we were all supposed to draft a report together. However, he did it -- he did his own report and I did my own.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And where is your report? Is it reflected in this one?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the procedure was as follows: I would forward my report to my superior, to my chief, and then they would forward it to the prosecution. And all those reports sent by various individuals who took part in the on-site investigations would then be put in a file and forwarded to the prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we see D814 one more time just briefly in order to determine the orientation. D814.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Witness, do you agree that the direction that you indicated here is more easterly than southerly? It is some 20 degrees bearing east, so that it's closer -- actually, it's more easterly than southerly?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no, this is really south-easterly.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. We can't find anywhere in the report or in the photo file that there were any fragments of an air-bomb found. We only see that there were some fragments of a VBR recovered; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I don't have the photo file before me right now, so I can't really answer that question accurately.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. We'll move on to the next one.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could we have a brief break, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. I was about to suggest it. We'll have a break for 10 minutes. We'll resume at 2.00. --- Break taken at 1.53 p.m.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can I remind you now about the incident in Hrasnica that we talked about during the examination-in-chief. Were you a part of the team investigating that, and what did you do there?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I was a part of that investigation of the Hrasnica incident.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. How soon after the incident did you go on site?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, we went out to the incident site in the afternoon hours, around 2.00 or 3.00 p.m., I think, because I know that I had come from down-town, from Sarajevo, and I had to pass through Dobrinja, and then the tunnel through Butmir all the way to Hrasnica. So it was quite a trip to get to the site, the incident site.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have 65 ter, please, 13565.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this Exhibit P1792.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said in the examination-in-chief that this area was an exclusively residential area where only private homes, civilians and residential buildings were. You said that; right?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Do we have the document before us? Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, could you please mark here Alekse Santica Street? I think the correct name is Izeta Aranica, but you can see the Alekse Santica Street. Can you indicate it?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you now please indicate where the Hrasnica cultural and sports centre was, the Famos playground?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this building here is the cultural and sports centre in Hrasnica [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you please mark it with the number 1.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And now show us where the post office was. Can you see the post office building? It's on Halid-bega Hrasnice. Street.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I don't know exactly where the post office building is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Can you see, across from this, the school building?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can see that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you please mark it, put a circle around it, and put the number 2 there.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did this used to be Alekse Santica School, and now it's the second elementary school in Hrasnica?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you now please date this document, and also your pseudonym.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Now, according to what you know, could you indicate the direction from which this projectile came, the one that you investigated?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can [marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And that is exactly across from the school building; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Could we now please have --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Or, rather, would you please date this and put your pseudonym.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Exhibit D815.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now have 65 ter 09758, and then page 10. We don't need the first page. The witness will recognise the 10th page as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: According to you, where was -- according to your findings, where did this projectile explode?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this projectile exploded on the house of Ferhatovic, Haso. It struck the house and then exploded.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It exploded outside the house; correct?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it struck the house, itself, and detonated inside the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What would the remainder of the house look like if the explosion was inside the house? Wouldn't parts of the house be scattered all over Hrasnica?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, they were. You're correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But can't you see that the structure of this house actually piled down, as it were? It wasn't scattered around; it remained within the perimeters of the house.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, no. We found the traces inside the house. As for the house, itself, it had two storeys, and it simply collapsed. It slumped down like a pile of cards.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. So on impact, on the roof of the house, the bomb detonated?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I don't know exactly where it detonated, but we found most of the trace evidence inside the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this photograph part of a P exhibit?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... 815, under seal.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now have page 32 of this document, please. This is Incident 10 from the G list, G schedule.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What happened to this roof?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, you can clearly see that all the tiles were blown away all over Hrasnica, and only a small number of tiles remained on the roof. Now, if you can see this garage next to the house, adjacent to the house, the metal structure, it was dented and it looked like a carton of milk if you were to squeeze it, and then it would be thinner at one end and broader at the other end.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. But do you agree with me that on this roof, the effect of the projectile explosion was like some kind of metal rain? It was outside of this structure?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes. In fact, this was the -- these were the effects of the blast wave when this explosive -- when this projectile exploded.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, you mentioned in your findings the skyscraper in the background. Why did you do that? Was it because you wanted to show that this was a residential area?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, and also for better orientation in -- spatial orientation.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. How far is this high-rise from the incident site or point of impact?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Several hundred metres.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we now see 65 ter 0 -- or, rather, this same document, but page 34, 3-4.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What we see in the background, is that the Alekse Santica School building?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: How far is that building from the point of impact?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, it is pretty close. It's some 100 to 150 metres; couldn't be more.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please indicate the school building on the photo by placing an arrow pointing at it?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, would you like me to circle it?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Please do so.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks] These are the windows of the Alekse Santica elementary School.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Our information indicates that it's 30 to 50 metres away from the place of the incident. Is that something that corresponds with your information?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think the distance is at least 100 metres. I don't know exactly, but it's not 30 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we have your initials and the date.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And can we tender this because it's been marked again? 816; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we have 1D2645 now, please. There is no signature, so I think that it doesn't have to be --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is this a diagram of that incident?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is the incoming trajectory of the projectile marked with the number 11?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Has this document been admitted?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: I believe the sketch is in evidence already, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: This is a part of -- must be a part of some report, then.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We put together two parts of the diagram for the sake of completeness, and we would like to ask the witness if that is his diagram. I wanted to ask the witness if this was put together correctly.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, it was.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not hear the last two questions and answers by the accused and the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll give a separate number for this.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D817, Your Honours. It's also part of 65 ter -- P1794, under seal.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] But we had to put it together in order to see the entire image.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Is the north here good?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we look at 1D2641, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you look at this picture, and do you agree that this -- the diagram applied to this Google map is well placed, in terms of "11," and this "2" is regularly parallel in relation to the projectile?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that a point here indicates the point of impact along the line marked with the number 2?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Does line number 2 cross precisely over the Alekse Santica School?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you now change that estimate of yours about the distance of the school from the place? For example, this gym is not even 50 metres away; would you agree?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that it's actually 100 metres here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All right. The street is five to six metres wide and so on?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the green area, the house, the yard -- I think it's the gym.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would you agree here that goes towards the place of the incident?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, probably.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you know -- can we tender this document, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: With the same caveat, we'll admit it as Exhibit D818.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you know what the Alekse Santica School was used for during the war?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't know that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Are you aware that the 104th Brigade of the Army of Bosnia and Herzegovina acted in Hrasnica with 4.500 men, and that all the facilities were being used for that brigade? Are you aware of that?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I'm not.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We still have enough time to just take a glance at 2D2642 [as interpreted]. I'm not going to press you on that. Others will deal with that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: But do you agree that in such a small area, 4.500 soldiers would make the area pretty dense?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know what to answer you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let's go to the video now. Let's look at 1D2647, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Mr. President, just before we go on, I do have a very short bit of re-examination to do which will take about two minutes. Secondly, I think we're about to see videos of ABiH training exercises, or something along those lines, which I submit this witness is not the right witness to comment on these videos. Mr. Karadzic can find another method to have them admitted, if that's his desire.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would just like to play it briefly just to see what that thing looks like, and it's a good thing for the witness to see.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you see Igman and Hrasnica? Do you agree that this is Hrasnica?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just could you wait.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I take it Mr. Gaynor's observation is correct, but the Chamber is wondering how the witness can help you in that regard, given his answer given to you already. Given the time, so could you conclude your cross-examination, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] All right, very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Mr. Witness, do you agree that in all these investigations, there was no work done to establish the distance, and the distance could not have been established either?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I would like to conclude the cross-examination with this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Okay, Mr. Karadzic. Yes, Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Could I, first of all, ask that 65 ter 09770 be brought up, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Witness, Mr. Karadzic asked you earlier on about the Majdanska Street incident on the 24th of May, 1995. Mr. Karadzic said to you: "We can't find anywhere in the report or in the photo file that there were any fragments of an air-bomb found. We can only see that there were some fragments of a VBR recovered; correct?" And your reply was that: "I don't have the photo file before me right now, so I can't really answer that question accurately." Now, that ends that extract. Could you just look at the first picture. If we could zoom in on the first picture. And the words under the first picture in front of you, that's a reference -- could you confirm that this is the first photograph in a photo file relating to the incident at Majdanska Street on the 24th of May, 1995?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can confirm that.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Could we now go to the fourth page of this document, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Could you describe what is marked with the figure "1" in that photograph?

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: The number "1" on this photograph, including the scale ruler which can be seen, indicates the connecting tin that was found in the crater that was created by this explosive device.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Could we see the next page, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Could we focus on the top photograph, please, and could you tell the Court what the numbers "2" and "3" refer to.

utterances.speaker: KDZ166 [Resumed]
utterances.text: The number "2" marks the container with the rocket fuel, and number "3" marks the shrapnel. However, at the end of the container, on the right-hand side of the photograph, you can see that it's a rocket engine. And as you're looking to the right, that's where the rocket engine is. And there, where the number "2" is, that is where the container with the rocket fuel is located.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Your Honours, photographs 15 and 16 are missing from this file, but the rest of the file contains photographs relating to this incident. I don't propose to go through any more of them. Your Honours can inspect them at the appropriate moment. I'd like to tender that in evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll admit it.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1817, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: No further re-examination. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Witness, that concludes your evidence. On behalf of the Chamber and the Tribunal, I'd like to thank you for your coming to The Hague to give it. Now you are free to go. Have a safe journey back home.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We need to draw the curtains so that the witness can excuse himself. Mr. Karadzic, did you want to say something?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I just said that the Defence also wishes to thank the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You may go now. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can you go back -- go into private session briefly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Is there anything further to be raised?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. If I could make an oral application that our expert, Dr. Subotic, be allowed to be present for the testimony of KDZ194, who will be testifying this week, who is a police officer, as well as Witnesses Besic and Dozo [phoen], who are also police officers, as well as Mr. Konings, who did a crater examination, and the expert, Berko Zecevic. We would ask that her presence be granted for those additional witnesses, and that should conclude all of the witnesses that the Prosecution has notified us of for which we need the assistance of an expert. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can we hear the response from the Prosecution on this point.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. In light of the nature of their evidence or parts of their evidence, we don't object to the request.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Gaynor. The request is granted. We'll resume tomorrow at 9.00. Let me check. Yes, 9.00 in the morning. We'll rise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 27th day of October, 2010, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.36 p.m.,
